mapper.select: SELECT id, name, threshold, amount, stock, expire_time, status FROM coupon WHERE status = 1 AND stock > 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT id, name, threshold, amount, stock, expire_time, status FROM coupon ORDER BY status DESC, expire_time DESC
SELECT id, name, threshold, amount, stock, expire_time, status FROM coupon WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.threshold, c.amount, c.stock, c.expire_time, c.status FROM coupon c JOIN user_coupon uc ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.used = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.expire_time > NOW() AND c.threshold <= #{totalAmount} ORDER BY c.amount DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (name, threshold, amount, stock, expire_time, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{threshold}, #{amount}, #{stock}, #{expireTime}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
